body:
Combines native Code Intelligence 0.5 parity checkpoint `c5178b2` and GitHub App checkpoint `7b8eabb`, preserving immutable source bytes, directed evidence and host-only authority. The integration repairs process cleanup, root/query scope, HTTP refusal cleanup, SQLite deadlines/opening and retained optional-provider compatibility. It adds verified captured Git history/mapping, bounded closed-PR discussions, an approved digest client, native authenticated intake, explicit received-metadata queries and atomic historical capture batches.

The digest client regenerates a body-excluding source/discussion handoff and requires exact payload/endpoint/workspace/App approval. Separate service/network/write grants precede one PUT behind an App-key-MACed durable intent. Unknown outcomes block retry and subsequent App/repository sends across installation changes; GET-only recovery validates the exact receipt and 404 remains unknown. The receiver authenticates fixed bearer-hash scopes before acquisition and rechecks revocation before committing exact bytes plus an immutable receipt. Received IDs never become local source/CAS/retention authority.

Received-metadata processing requires independent host and per-principal query grants, default false. All selected packets are scoped before release. Receipt-qualified JSON positions preserve duplicate symbols and directed parallel commit-parent/reply/review relationships. Literal Unicode search, pagination and work/output/deadline bounds retain unverified sender provenance and false semantic/source-authority flags. Local queries open existing read-only state; remote queries make one TLS POST with only the service token, without a sender Store or signing-key lookup.

The new `digest-history-capture` path explicitly selects and captures one bounded verified-head history batch plus direct parents. It inherits the proven head epoch and exact disk-origin scope. Shared file/source/commit/tree allowances precede object retention; fresh source mapping and exact output admission precede one owned immediate WAL/FULL transaction publishing snapshot, graph, FTS, inherited scope, artifact registration and source receipt together. A late second-target failure rolls back the prepared first target as well. Single-commit Git capture now shares the atomic SQL boundary. Checkout/Git refs/index/latest, credentials and model/provider/network state are unchanged. Durable CAS bytes can remain unreferenced after failure and grant no authority. Persistent whole-history jobs/automatic continuation and unattended App integration remain open.

Other repairs retain typed Windows cleanup failures, terminate/reap owned jobs before inherited pipe waits, preserve the runtime drive in filtered launchers, retain host root aliases, distinguish POSIX literal spelling and bound refusal-tail cleanup. Store operations/opening retain absolute deadlines/cancellation across client locks and SQLite work. Captured mapping checks physical executable mode without forced checkout. TypeScript bridges isolate Graphify caches and verify materialized inputs. Earlier actual Graft/Graphify and anonymous native GitHub HTTPS results remain bound to their separate checkpoints; raw foreign discussion text is not published.

Frozen validation at `8fa03c5`:

- **Every testable native Cargo target executed**: 262 testable targets plus the example harness, **263 result groups with 2,389 passed / 10 failed / 39 ignored**. All ten new actual Git/SQLite/CLI acquisition cases pass, including SHA1/SHA256, epochs8/9, Unicode/CRLF, dirty checkout, repeat identity, exact output limits, aggregate budgets, corruption and atomic multi-target failure.
- **All ten failures are independently confirmed Windows error1314 during real symbolic-link fixture creation.** The underlying safety assertion is not reached; tests are unchanged. The full default native run is not accepted. A source/CLI/test-hash-bound manual elevated replay is prepared and parsed, not executed; no Windows rights/developer-mode change or self-elevation occurs.
- Format, all-target Clippy with warnings denied, doctests (zero registered), **17 Python tests**, **260 TypeScript tests / 3 existing skips**, typecheck and **two actual Windows OS-credential/TLS CLI gates** pass. All **640 recorded runtime/test/configuration inputs remain byte-identical** during final validation.
- **81 raw artifacts** and all640 inputs verified against committed Git blobs (90 raw-equal/550 explicitly recorded CRLF-only materializations; all seven changed runtime/test files raw-equal). Two prior linker disk-space failures executed zero native tests and are preserved separately. Ordinary reversible NTFS compression preserved all10,542 generated-file hashes; no data was deleted. Final Cargo compiler/linker concurrency is one, with full target selection and two test threads unchanged.

[Acquisition contract](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/8fa03c5e6f2f8acc30ec26caebe255d2220ce9a6/native/docs/digest-history-acquisition.md), [query contract](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/8fa03c5e6f2f8acc30ec26caebe255d2220ce9a6/native/docs/digest-query.md), [receiver contract](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/8fa03c5e6f2f8acc30ec26caebe255d2220ce9a6/native/docs/digest-receiver.md), [full evidence](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/8fa03c5e6f2f8acc30ec26caebe255d2220ce9a6/docs/validation/integration-2026-10-19/digest-history-acquisition/index.json) and [pending Windows prerequisite replay](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/8fa03c5e6f2f8acc30ec26caebe255d2220ce9a6/docs/validation/integration-2026-10-19/digest-history-acquisition/WINDOWS-REPARSE-GATES.md) describe precise inputs, outcomes and limits.

This remains a draft. Persistent automatic whole-history continuation, unattended App integration, public production, remote source verification, semantic reasoning, live App installation/deployment and other STATUS/R1-R9 requirements remain open. All original inventory identities, unreconciled/backend-unknown states and false full-contract certifications are retained. Hosted Windows/Linux/macOS acceptance needs current evidence. No main merge, release, public comment or deployment is claimed; ZIP/VSIX artifacts at `9f48353` predate these repairs.
title: Integrate native Code Intelligence 0.5 checkpoints and GitHub App workflows
